name: weavl
description: AIGC content production studio. Every template is a declarative, model-agnostic workflow pack — add a new vertical by shipping data, not code.

scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:infra && pnpm run dev:apps
scripts.dev:infra:stop: docker compose --env-file deploy/dev.env -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml stop postgres redis minio
scripts.lint: eslint apps/api/src packages/shared/src --max-warnings=0 && pnpm --filter @weavl/web run lint
scripts.lint:fix: eslint apps/api/src packages/shared/src --fix --max-warnings=0 && pnpm --filter @weavl/web run lint:fix
